registry_name: Rocket Trader Public Reference Strategy Registry

references.name: Time-series momentum / trend following
references.organization: AQR Capital Management / Journal of Financial Economics
references.original_scope: 58 liquid futures and forward contracts across equity indexes, currencies, commodities and sovereign bonds; return persistence over approximately 1 to 12 months with partial reversal at longer horizons.
references.rule_hypothesis: Measure each instrument's own trailing excess return over multiple lookbacks. Positive trend may support a long position; negative trend is cash/flat in Rocket Trader's initial long-only implementation.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Test long-only versions on US equities/ETFs and crypto spot separately. Do not copy futures short exposure, leverage, contract roll assumptions or published results into spot markets.
limitations: The original study is not a proof that the same rule works on SPY, QQQ or crypto spot.
Its multi-month horizons are not directly comparable to intraday signals.
All adaptations require new out-of-sample tests after costs.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Predeclared 1/3/6/12-month own-asset returns; long or cash; volatility-scaled exposure with capped risk.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Whipsaw, crash after trend reversal, concentration, delayed signal, transaction costs.
references.evidence_grade: A: peer-reviewed futures evidence; target-market transfer unproven.
references.test_protocol: Chronological walk-forward, next-open, block bootstrap, multiple-testing correction, same-asset buy-and-hold and cash.

references.name: Cross-sectional stock momentum
references.original_scope: US stock winner/loser portfolios with holding horizons in the 3-to-12-month range.
references.rule_hypothesis: Rank a point-in-time eligible equity universe by trailing relative performance, with a skip/reversal window tested separately. Compare top-ranked securities against the broad-market benchmark.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Long-only top-ranked basket; no shorting. Universe membership, delisted securities, corporate actions, survivorship bias, turnover, spread and borrow-free assumptions must be handled explicitly.
limitations: The published long-short strategy cannot be copied as-is because Rocket Trader starts without short selling.
Historical results may not survive current costs, universe changes or a different holding period.
Do not rank today's constituents in historical periods unless point-in-time membership is reconstructed.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Rank eligible assets by 3-12 month returns with predeclared skip window; long-only top basket.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Momentum crashes, survivorship bias, universe drift, turnover, sector concentration.
references.evidence_grade: A: peer-reviewed equities evidence; implementation-specific.
references.test_protocol: Point-in-time universe, delisted names, next-open, turnover/cost stress, benchmark and factor controls.

references.name: Long-history trend-following reference
references.original_scope: Historical trend-following analysis across multiple markets and long periods, extending back to the nineteenth century.
references.rule_hypothesis: Use diversified trend-following rules and risk scaling as a reference family; test robustness across market regimes rather than optimize one instrument.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Treat as a research design reference. Build separate long-only stock/ETF and crypto-spot variants; no futures, shorts or leverage.
limitations: Historical reconstructed performance is not a guarantee of future returns.
The source includes markets and instruments not available in the initial Rocket Trader scope.
Costs, execution and data quality must be re-estimated for each target market.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Diversified trend signals with predeclared lookbacks and volatility scaling; long-only/cash adaptation.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Whipsaw, crowded exits, volatility spikes, long-only asymmetry.
references.evidence_grade: B: institutional historical reconstruction; not directly transferable.
references.test_protocol: Multiple regimes, rolling OOS, drawdown and tail analysis, risk-matched benchmarks.

references.name: Long-horizon value, business quality and capital stewardship
references.original_scope: Long-term business ownership, intrinsic value, capital allocation and shareholder stewardship; not an intraday trading system.
references.rule_hypothesis: Use business quality, durable economics, valuation discipline and long-term capital allocation as a separate slow-horizon reference.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Do not use this qualitative reference as an intraday signal. It can inform a distinct long-horizon ETF/equity research sleeve only after reliable point-in-time fundamental data is available.
limitations: This is not a fully specified algorithmic rule set.
Berkshire's historical results are not an achievable benchmark for a small automated account.
Do not infer current positions from delayed public disclosures as if they were real-time orders.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Separate slow-horizon sleeve using point-in-time valuation and business quality; not intraday.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Stale accounting, value traps, survivorship, accounting restatements, data cost.
references.evidence_grade: C: qualitative practitioner reference.
references.test_protocol: Only when point-in-time fundamentals and survivorship-safe universe exist; benchmark factor exposures.

references.name: Jesse Livermore — trend and loss discipline
references.organization: Historical practitioner reference, summarized in AQR research
references.original_scope: Qualitative emphasis on assessing the broad market trend, cutting losses and letting profitable trends continue.
references.rule_hypothesis: Test explicit trend filters, predefined exits and risk limits as separate hypotheses.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Use only to formulate testable rules. Do not treat quotations, anecdotes or claimed historical returns as statistical evidence.
limitations: No verified machine-readable trade ledger is supplied by this source.
Anecdotal success cannot populate BenchmarkEvent records.
Only independently tested quantitative rules may affect strategy selection.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Translate loss discipline and trend-following into explicit stop/exit hypotheses.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Anecdotal source, discretionary ambiguity, parameter mining.
references.evidence_grade: C: qualitative practitioner reference.
references.test_protocol: Test exact rules against simple trend/cash baselines; no performance inference from biography.

references.name: Buy-and-hold benchmark
references.original_scope: Passive holding-period return of the same asset or broad-market proxy.
references.rule_hypothesis: Measure whether active strategies add net value over holding the same asset through the same dates.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Use as a mandatory benchmark for SPY/QQQ and as an asset-specific buy-and-hold comparator for crypto spot.
limitations: Use identical dates and include dividends/corporate actions where applicable.
A risk-matched cash or volatility-matched baseline is also required when exposures differ.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Hold the same asset/universe over identical dates; compare net active return.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Benchmark mismatch, dividend omissions, exposure mismatch.
references.evidence_grade: A: mandatory baseline.
references.test_protocol: Same asset, dates, capital, currency, and total-return convention; include risk-matched cash.

references.name: Short-horizon RSI mean reversion
references.organization: New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems
references.original_scope: RSI indicator reference; exact RSI(2) strategy is a separate Rocket Trader hypothesis.
references.rule_hypothesis: Pre-register RSI(2)<10 entry with trend filter; exit by fixed horizon or RSI recovery; long-only/cash.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Pre-register RSI(2)<10 entry with trend filter; exit by fixed horizon or RSI recovery; long-only/cash.
limitations: RSI indicator is not proof of an edge.
Strong trends can keep RSI extreme; sparse trades and costs matter.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Pre-register RSI(2)<10 entry with trend filter; exit by fixed horizon or RSI recovery; long-only/cash.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Catching falling knives, regime shifts, gap risk, low sample size, costs.
references.evidence_grade: C: indicator/practitioner rule; specific adaptation unproven.
references.test_protocol: Compare RSI threshold to unconditional and trend-filtered controls; next-open, nested walk-forward, Holm family.

references.name: Bollinger-band mean reversion
references.original_scope: Study of Bollinger-band rules and transaction costs.
references.rule_hypothesis: Test lower-band entry and middle-band exit as a fixed hypothesis; long-only.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Test lower-band entry and middle-band exit as a fixed hypothesis; long-only.
limitations: Published study reports no consistent excess over buy-and-hold after costs for tested rules.
Band touches can signal trend continuation, not reversal.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Test lower-band entry and middle-band exit as a fixed hypothesis; long-only.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Trend persistence, volatility expansion, repeated entries, fees and slippage.
references.evidence_grade: B: peer-reviewed rule study; outcome depends on market and period.
references.test_protocol: Pre-register parameters; next-open; compare buy-and-hold/cash; report trades and net expectancy; multiple-test correction.

references.name: Cointegration / distance-based pairs trading
references.original_scope: US equity pairs selected by historical distance; classic long-short relative-value strategy.
references.rule_hypothesis: Research-only long/short spread: select pairs on train window, estimate hedge ratio, enter z-score divergence, exit convergence/stop/time stop. No live eligibility under current cash-only/no-short policy.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Research-only long/short spread: select pairs on train window, estimate hedge ratio, enter z-score divergence, exit convergence/stop/time stop. No live eligibility under current cash-only/no-short policy.
limitations: Original strategy is long-short and depends on short availability/borrow.
Cointegration and economic relationships can break; structural breaks and corporate actions.
Pairs selection and universe survivorship can create bias.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Research-only long/short spread: select pairs on train window, estimate hedge ratio, enter z-score divergence, exit convergence/stop/time stop. No live eligibility under current cash-only/no-short policy.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Non-stationarity, legging risk, borrow costs, short restrictions, correlated news, parameter instability.
references.evidence_grade: A: peer-reviewed strategy literature; target universe and execution unproven.
references.test_protocol: Train/select/test chronologically; rolling cointegration stability; both legs executable; include borrow, fees, legging and gap risk; compare matched risk controls.

references.name: Pairs trading with short-term reversal and pairs momentum
references.original_scope: Equity pairs results and decomposition into reversal and pairs momentum.
references.rule_hypothesis: Decompose pair signal into reversal and industry/pairs momentum; only simulated until shorting and borrow data are supported.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Decompose pair signal into reversal and industry/pairs momentum; only simulated until shorting and borrow data are supported.
limitations: Not a long-only strategy; cannot transfer published results directly.
Relative-value signals may be explained by industry momentum and short-term reversal.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Decompose pair signal into reversal and industry/pairs momentum; only simulated until shorting and borrow data are supported.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Leg risk, factor confounding, regime instability, borrow and transaction costs.
references.evidence_grade: A: peer-reviewed study.
references.test_protocol: Ablation tests; compare pair composite to each component and industry momentum; next-executable-bar OOS; costs and short constraints.

references.name: Volatility-managed exposure overlay
references.original_scope: Volatility-managed portfolios across factor portfolios.
references.rule_hypothesis: Scale a separately validated base strategy to a predeclared volatility target with hard caps and no leverage.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Scale a separately validated base strategy to a predeclared volatility target with hard caps and no leverage.
limitations: Published factor results do not establish edge in Rocket Trader.

references.entry_exit_sizing: Scale a separately validated base strategy to a predeclared volatility target with hard caps and no leverage.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.

references.name: Calendar seasonality and turn-of-month effects
references.original_scope: Historical January seasonality in equity returns.
references.rule_hypothesis: Pre-register a small number of calendar windows (turn-of-month, month-end, weekday) with no post-hoc date mining.
references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Pre-register a small number of calendar windows (turn-of-month, month-end, weekday) with no post-hoc date mining.
limitations: Historical seasonality may decay and can be explained by changing market structure.
Multiple calendar slices create severe data-snooping risk.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Pre-register a small number of calendar windows (turn-of-month, month-end, weekday) with no post-hoc date mining.
references.execution_assumptions: Signal computed only from completed data; orders at next executable bar/open; include spread, fees, slippage, latency, partial fills, rejects, corporate actions and cash constraints. No look-ahead.
references.failure_modes: Data snooping, changing tax/market structure, small effective sample, costs.

references.test_protocol: Use many independent years, placebo dates, block bootstrap, Holm correction, prospective test.

references.rocket_trader_adaptation: Only use information available at event time; trade next executable session after a predeclared surprise threshold.
limitations: Requires point-in-time earnings and analyst expectations; not available in current baseline data.
Publication timestamps, after-hours gaps, revisions and survivorship matter.
references.entry_exit_sizing: Only use information available at event time; trade next executable session after a predeclared surprise threshold.

coverage_note: Practical strategy taxonomy, not an exhaustive list of every strategy ever proposed. New entries are hypotheses or references, not approvals. Availability constraints are explicit.
